# Card r1-s-2: Rage-Fed Lunger

## Brainstorm half

### Identity

- Class: Warrior
- Ascendancy: Titan
- Named damage source: Blood Hunt

### Pitch

- Name: Rage-Fed Lunger
- Why pick it: Rage built on every hit makes each lunge bigger, and the rage wheel keeps it topped up.
- How it clears: Hit the pack to build rage, then lunge through it.
- Bosses: Spend rage on the burst lunge.
- Needs: a two-handed spear and the rage wheel; online by act 2; no respec; cheap
- The catch: Rage decays between packs.
- Playstyle: melee, few-buttons, clear

### Chain

- Damage source: Blood Hunt, carried by the weapon in Weapon 1.
- Multipliers: its supports.
- Enablers: none.
- Consumes or requires: nothing.
